newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL downgrades Thapar Milk Products bonds.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL downgrades Thapar Milk Products bonds.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Tuesday it downgraded outstanding rating of the partly convertible debenture issue of Thapar Milk Products Limited (TMPL).

CRISIL downgraded the security to "D" from "C." "C" indicates substantial risk in timely payment of interest and principal while "D" indicates that the rated debentures are in default and in arrears of interest and principal payments.
The commercial production at the firm's Alwar unit commenced on November 1994, 15 months behind schedule but within the estimated cost of 210 million rupees.
The company has at present 80 milk collection centres and 5 chilling centres. It procures the bulk of its milk supplies through its collection centres and from the nearby villages.
